projects.title: HomeVeal Bathroom Remodeling: AI Lead-to-Appointment System
projects.problem: HomeVeal needed more than a simple form or chatbot: a connected system that captures remodeling inquiries, collects the information required for qualification, prevents unsuitable appointments, and helps eligible leads move toward a scheduled consultation. Leads can arrive with incomplete details, outside the service area, or through different channels with inconsistent context.
projects.solution: A lead-to-appointment system combining a conversion-focused landing page, GoHighLevel CRM and pipeline management, n8n workflow orchestration, a Vapi AI voice agent, AI-assisted qualification, service-area validation, appointment scheduling, reminders, and follow-up automation.
projects.publishedOutcome: A reusable lead-to-appointment foundation connecting the website, AI agents, CRM, workflows, service-area rules, calendar, and follow-up.
projects.privacyNote: Private client system. Screenshots and examples are anonymized where necessary. Private webhook URLs, credentials and exact service-area details are omitted.

sections.heading: Project overview
sections.body: HomeVeal serves homeowners looking for remodeling and home improvement services in Northeast Ohio, including the Cleveland, Akron, and Canton market. This project focused on building a reliable customer journey from first inquiry to qualified appointment.
items: Lead capture: landing page and intake flows collect the details needed for follow-up
AI qualification: voice and chat agents gather missing details and keep conversations on track
Service-area validation: configured area checks keep booking focused on eligible locations
CRM and pipeline management in GoHighLevel: contacts, tags, custom fields, and lead progress
Appointment booking: preferred times are checked against availability before a booking is treated as confirmed
Automated follow-up: confirmations, reminders, and follow-up keep eligible leads moving

sections.heading: The challenge
items: Leads may submit incomplete information
Some contacts may only provide a first name
Address, ZIP code, phone number, email, service request, or preferred schedule may be missing
Leads outside the configured service area should not be allowed to book
The AI agent must not ask customers to repeat information already available
Appointment availability must be checked before confirming a booking
Different channels, including voice and SMS, should use consistent customer context
The team needs a reusable structure that can later support additional markets

sections.heading: System architecture
items: Homeowner

Vapi AI voice agent and AI qualification
n8n webhook and workflow processing
GoHighLevel contact, tags, custom fields, and pipeline

Appointment booking
Confirmation, reminders, and follow-up

sections.heading: Conversation safeguards
sections.body: Tony, the HomeVeal AI voice agent, collects or confirms name, phone, email, address, ZIP code, requested service and preferred appointment time.
items: Uses known customer information and avoids asking for the same information again
Asks for missing information when required and confirms the full name before important actions
Does not claim that an appointment is booked until the booking result is confirmed

sections.heading: Qualification and service-area protection
items: If information is missing, the AI asks for the missing details
If the address or ZIP code is outside the service area, the lead is marked appropriately and should not be allowed to book
If the lead is eligible and the information is complete, the system can continue toward scheduling

projects.title: Tony AI: Trainable AI Negotiation and Conversation Platform
projects.anonymizedTitle: Trainable AI negotiation and conversation platform
projects.problem: Generic AI assistants often respond in a neutral and inconsistent way, do not automatically understand how a specific person thinks, talks, or negotiates, and rarely handle objections, business decisions, or roleplay with a stable character.
projects.solution: A character-based conversational AI with chat and voice modes sharing one AI brain, a teaching mode, stored corrections, long-term memory, and a business knowledge base. Improvements come from stored corrections, memories and instructions retrieved into future responses, not from retraining the underlying model.
projects.publishedOutcome: A reusable AI brain that combines chat, voice, stored corrections, long-term memory, business knowledge, and character-based responses.
projects.privacyNote: Private experimental AI product. Screenshots and internal configuration have been anonymized where necessary. Counters shown in screenshots are sample UI state, not production performance metrics.
limitations: Tony is a training and conversation partner. It does not replace a human negotiator or make guaranteed business decisions.
Tony does not permanently retrain the underlying AI model from every conversation; corrections and memories are retrieved into future responses.
Memory is retrieved based on relevance, not perfect recall of every past chat.

sections.heading: Project overview
sections.body: Tony AI was built as a standalone trainable AI platform for realistic conversations, negotiation practice, sales training, and business-specific AI behavior. It is separate from HomeVeal, where a Tony voice agent was later applied inside a remodeling workflow.
items: Chat conversations with negotiation starters and a character-driven reply style
Voice interaction using the same Tony Brain
Teaching mode that lets users shape how Tony thinks while they talk
Stored corrections: preferred responses saved and retrieved later
Long-term memory for important facts and instructions
Business knowledge: guide content, niches, and knowledge-base layers

projects.title: Zorivelle Realty Chatbot: RAG-Powered Document Q&A
projects.problem: Property information is spread across files and can change. A generic chatbot may answer fluently without using the correct project details.
projects.solution: An n8n ingestion process reads Google Drive documents, chunks and embeds their content, and stores vectors in Supabase pgvector. A webhook agent retrieves relevant passages for each question and passes them to Gemini as constrained context for the final answer.
projects.publishedOutcome: Sales information becomes searchable through conversation while source documents remain the grounding layer.
limitations: Answers are only as current as the indexed documents.
Retrieval reduces unsupported answers but does not eliminate model error.

projects.title: AI Email Agent: Classification, Knowledge Reply, and Human Review
projects.anonymizedTitle: AI email agent with human review
projects.problem: Repetitive questions consume inbox time, but automatic responses become risky when the model lacks confidence or the request falls outside known guidance.
projects.solution: Zapier coordinates Gmail, OpenAI, a Google Sheets knowledge base, and Slack. Each email receives a category and confidence assessment. Eligible messages use knowledge-base material to draft a reply, while low-confidence cases are summarized in Slack with a suggested response for a person to decide.
projects.publishedOutcome: Predictable questions follow an automated route while nuanced messages remain visible to a reviewer.
limitations: Confidence scores are model signals, not guarantees.
Sensitive or novel requests should always remain with a person.

projects.title: 4BR Guest Follow-Up: QR Check-In and Conditional Sequences
projects.problem: Event follow-up becomes confusing when attendance records are delayed or contacts enter conflicting campaigns. Continued messages after a reply can also harm the experience.
projects.solution: A GoHighLevel attendance system: a QR-triggered webhook applies attendance state, router conditions and exclusion checks choose one nurture branch (attended or no-show), and reply events remove contacts from active messaging.
projects.publishedOutcome: Attendees and no-shows receive distinct communication, with reply handling designed to stop unnecessary messages.
limitations: Missed or duplicate scans can affect attendance state.
Staff need a correction process for inaccurate check-ins.

Prevent entry into competing sequences
Stop follow-up once a guest responds

sections.heading: How it works

Locate or update the GHL contact
Apply the attendance tag
Evaluate attended versus no-show rules
Enter one follow-up sequence
Stop messages when the contact replies
